## Featured Projects

- [Aegis3D](https://github.com/m4ulikP/Aegis3D)
  AI-powered structural health monitoring and sensor telemetry prototype. Built with FastAPI, NumPy, SciPy, PostgreSQL, and Server-Sent Events (SSE). Implements a deterministic 9-stage signal processing pipeline featuring Butterworth filtering, sample window burst detection, FFT/RMS feature extraction, dynamic baseline tracking, z-score anomaly scoring, and an explainable 0–100 Structural Health Index.
- [OutreachOS](https://github.com/m4ulikP/OutreachOS)
  Freelancer sales studio and lead management application. Built with Next.js 14 App Router, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, and Zod. Features a deterministic 3-tier deduplication engine (email normalization, canonical LinkedIn URL parsing, and composite key matching), a 6-stage sales progression pipeline, and transactional email dispatch with exponential retry handling.

## Technical Skills & Background

- **Background & Education:** Computer Science & Engineering undergraduate at IILM University specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML). Completed Machine Learning Specialization by DeepLearning.AI & Stanford Online.
- **Experience:** Former Backend AI Engineer Intern at Flyrank AI (Jul 1 – Aug 26, 2026), developing FastAPI services, RAG retrieval pipelines, LLM APIs with structured outputs, and evaluation workflows.
- **Programming Languages:** Python, Java, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript.
- **Backend & Systems:** FastAPI, REST APIs, Server-Sent Events (SSE), PostgreSQL, Alembic, Docker, Git, GitHub.
- **AI & Data Science:** Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLM APIs & Function Calling, NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib.
